import_policy: any valid PySpark import style; F alias not mandatory
report_format: [PASS] Visible Test Case N Passed: name / [FAIL] Visible Test Case N Failed: name with Expected/Actual/Reason/Fix detail lines
runner_contract: Candidate logic failures are recorded in test_report.log and do not produce a non-zero process exit code; true runner/report-generation failures may return non-zero.
qa_gate: Reference solution must pass all 6 tests in strict QA mode; evaluator imports must not wildcard-import pyspark.sql.functions.
